question: Should ClawHub standardize new skill display names at 40 characters with grandfathering for existing over-limit names?
rationale: The linked issue asks for concise titles but does not choose the exact maximum or legacy behavior, and those choices affect existing catalog data.

options.title: Accept 40 with repaired grandfathering
options.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the GitHub exact-limit repair, focused regression coverage, real behavior proof, and green merge gates before merge.

options.title: Choose a different title policy
options.body: Ask the contributor to adjust the shared constant, UI copy, sync behavior, and tests to the maintainer-approved maximum and legacy rules.

options.title: Defer the policy
options.body: Keep the linked issue open as the policy tracker and pause this PR if maintainers are not ready to enforce a stored catalog display-name limit.

recommendation.title: Accept 40 with repaired grandfathering
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction, but require the GitHub exact-limit repair, focused regression coverage, real behavior proof, and green merge gates before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest history match for both GitHub-backed sync and hosted publish paths touched by this policy.
